Considering the legal scenario revolving around Section 328 of I.P.C., I deem it appropriate to protect the applicant by the following ad- interim order.

(a) In the event of arrest in connection with C.R.No.736 of 2022 registered with Manpada Police Station, applicant-Suraj Harish Thakkar shall be released on bail on furnishing P.R. Bond to the extent of Rs.25,000/- with one or two sureties in the like amount.
(b) The applicant shall report to the concerned police station on Thursday between 3.00 p.m. to 5.00 p.m. for a period of two weeks and, thereafter, as and when called for.

(c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing the facts to Court or any Police Offcer and shall not tamper with evidence.
3. List the application on 23/11/2022.
( SMT. BHARATI DANGRE, J.) M.M.Salgaonkar Suraj Harish Thakkar vs The State Of Maharashtra on 17 October, 2022 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/121829310/
